channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Mark Tatum | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Mark Tatum from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Chus Bueno on Adam Silver, Mark Tatum
item.description:
said Bueno, andadmitted that everything is on the table:

“We are open to exploring, but this doesn’t mean it’s going to happen. There’s no time pressure for us or the NBA, but there’s a matter of momentum. Adam Silver said it, Mark Tatum said it, fragmentation is losing value. It would be better to maximise the opportunity together with the NBA”

Chus Bueno on Adam Silver, Mark Tatum, May 23, 2026. Source: EuroHoops.net.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Mark Tatum
item.description:
“(PR man) Raymond (Ridder) had drawn up a fake fine letter with an NBA letterhead and everything, signed by like Mark Tatum. It said something like: ‘In accordance with Rule 3, Bylaw 2.1, you will be fined $25,000 for the shoes you wore on January 10th.’”

Steve Kerr on Mark Tatum, Oct 23, 2022. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Joe Dumars on Mark Tatum
item.description:
Dumars told Yahoo Sports recently.

“As soon as I retired from playing at 36 (in 1999), this probably wasn't the move for me. I had to live and get more experience. “Once I started talking to Adam (Silver, NBA commissioner) and Mark Tatum (deputy commissioner), just over a period of time, it became very clear that this was like a seamless transition for me. So I'm super happy with the decision to do so. Everything I've done up until this point, led me to this particular move right here.”

Joe Dumars on Mark Tatum, Aug 12, 2022. Source: Yahoo! Sports.

item.title: Jerry Colangelo on Mark Tatum
item.description:
Nonetheless, Colangelo is doing his best to prepare Team USA for as many possible scenarios as he can envision.

“I’ve been on the phone with (NBA deputy commissioner) Mark Tatum about this, and he said all sorts of possibilities are on the table, but things change every day,”

Jerry Colangelo on Mark Tatum, Sep 29, 2020. Source: basketballnews.com.
